components.css: .ds-desktop-nav { padding: 1.25rem 0.75rem; background: #f0f3f3; border-right: 1px solid var(--line); } .ds-desktop-nav nav, .ds-nav-group { display: grid; gap: 0.15rem; } .ds-nav-group h2 { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; padding: 0 0.6rem; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.035em; } .ds-nav-link { display: flex; min-height: 2.45rem; align-items: center; padding: 0.48rem 0.65rem; color: var(--ink-soft); border-radius: 0.45rem; font-size: 0.86rem; font-weight: 560; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link--current { color: var(--accent); background: var(--accent-soft); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible, .ds-mobile-nav summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-mobile-nav { display: none; } @media (max-width: 900px) { .ds-desktop-nav { display: none; } .ds-mobile-nav { display: block; position: relative; } .ds-mobile-nav > summary { min-height: 2.6rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-control); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.83rem; font-weight: 700; list-style: none; } .ds-mobile-nav nav { position: absolute; z-index: 1; top: calc(100% + 0.45rem); right: 0; width: min(20rem, calc(100vw - 1.25rem)); max-height: min(72vh, 36rem); overflow: auto; padding: 0.85rem; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-panel); } }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a task surface, with a clear focus ring and restrained crimson hover state.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.65rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.56rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-control); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button--primary { color: #fff; background: var(--accent); } .ds-button--primary:hover { color: #fff; background: var(--accent-hover); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Labeled Search Field
components.description: A visibly labeled, keyboard-accessible search field for student lookup.

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-field-label { color: var(--ink); font-size: 0.84rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-field-control { width: 100%; min-height: 2.65rem; padding: 0.55rem 0.7rem; color: var(--ink); background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-control); font-size: 0.92rem; } .ds-field-control:hover { border-color: #82979c; } .ds-field-control:focus { border-color: var(--accent); outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 19%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-field-help { margin: 0.15rem 0 0; color: var(--muted); font-size: 0.78rem; }

components.css: .ds-workspace-panel { padding: 1.15rem; background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line); border-radius: var(--radius-panel); } .ds-workspace-panel h2 { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; color: var(--ink); font-size: 1.18rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; } .ds-workspace-panel p { max-width: 70ch; margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft); font-size: 0.96rem; line-height: 1.5; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A bordered white action for a secondary task.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.65rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.56rem 0.9rem; color: var(--ink); background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong); border-radius: var(--radius-control); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { color: var(--accent); background: #f8fafa; border-color: var(--accent); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: An explicit destructive action, kept separate from the primary action.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.65rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0.56rem 0.9rem; color: var(--danger); background: #fff; border: 1px solid #dcb7bf; border-radius: var(--radius-control); cursor: pointer; font-size: 0.88rem; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.2; text-align: center; transition: background-color 160ms ease, color 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button:hover { background: var(--danger-soft); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--focus) 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Pending Status Chip
components.description: Text and a warm background communicate a pending workflow state without relying on color alone.
components.css: .ds-status-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.18rem 0.55rem; color: var(--ink-soft); background: var(--surface-soft); border-radius: 0.35rem; font-size: 0.74rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: capitalize; } .ds-status-chip--pending { color: var(--warning); background: var(--warning-soft); }

narrative.overview:
ARKTIESIIS is a centralized school records system. The calm school-app direction keeps the official seal, institution name, and Lucena Branch visible while staff work through searchable records, enrollment, document review, finance, and grade approval. Students see current-term context, today's classes, and their own school information.

Near-white surfaces, readable ink, cool rules, restrained crimson, compact panels, and one system sans family keep dense school work familiar. Desktop authenticated pages use grouped navigation; narrower screens switch to a native disclosure menu.
keyCharacteristics: The shared masthead keeps the official seal, institution name, and Lucena Branch visible.
Desktop authenticated pages show role-filtered destinations in grouped sidebar navigation; narrower screens use a native disclosure menu.
Staff work centers on searchable records, enrollment, document review, finance, and grade approval; student pages start with the current term and today's classes.
Compact neutral panels and restrained crimson support dense forms, records, review histories, and finance ledgers.

rules.name: The Shared Identity Rule
rules.body: Keep the official seal, institution name, and Lucena Branch visible in the shared masthead.

rules.name: The Current Task Rule
rules.body: The page title and current task begin in the content area.

rules.name: The Text-First Status Rule
rules.body: Maintain readable contrast on neutral and status backgrounds; do not communicate status by color alone.

dos: Keep a visible keyboard focus indicator, a skip link, semantic headings, labeled navigation groups, and explicitly labeled form controls.
Use native <details> and <summary> controls for the mobile navigation menu.
Maintain readable contrast on neutral and status backgrounds; do not communicate status by color alone.
Preserve the supplied official seal and campus image unchanged.
donts: Do not invent school policy, document-verification claims, live operational counts, or spreadsheet compatibility.
Do not add page-load choreography or decorative motion.
